required_review_dimensions.description: Candidate remains a deterministic local reference credential lease gate with no real secret-manager/provider side effect or authority widening.
Exact accepted Slice8 result and completion hashes, binding hash, idempotency key, remote result digest/status and lineage are validated before broker access.
Candidate consumes the actual accepted Slice8 output shape rather than an invented synthetic upstream schema.
Slice9 terminal_binding_hash is sourced from and checked against Slice8 completion evidence binding_hash, not caller-controlled bound_remote_execution metadata.
Tampered Slice8 result_hash, remote_completion_hash or binding_hash is rejected before credential broker access.
Provider/profile identity substitution and caller-supplied replacement credential identities are rejected.
Raw secret inputs are rejected and raw secret values do not enter governed records, evidence or diagnostics.
Lease scope cannot exceed either accepted terminal lineage or current credential-profile policy.
Profile validity window, epoch/snapshot, profile revocation, lease expiry and explicit lease revocation are rechecked fail closed at use time.
Exact replay is non-amplifying; changed lease/request binding, stale lease refresh and forged/unknown opaque handles are denied.
Credential possession, opaque handle, broker/model/reviewer/CI self-report cannot substitute for terminal authorization or create production authority.
Restart/recovery retains only bounded lease metadata and preserves replay semantics without governed raw-secret persistence.
Synthetic future provider/profile works through data-driven registry/config behavior without provider-specific evidence/dashboard branches.
Pre-mechanism red, initial false green, real-Slice8 defect exposure, stale-fixture failure and final repaired qualification are all preserved and correctly classified.
Run 34340343645 qualifies exact candidate 16ae65c9d4939efc05aeff76f0ae2e708428b3b1 with Slice9 and all preserved regressions green.
Adversarial review finds no material remaining contract/evidence/secret/replay/authority bypass within bounded Slice9 scope.
